name: Birth of Napoleon
description: Napoleon Bonaparte is born on August 15, 1769.

name: Napoleon's Military Training
description: Napoleon receives military education at the Royal Military School in Brienne-le-Château.

name: The French Revolution
description: The French Revolution begins, marking a period of radical social and political change in France.

name: Siege of Toulon
description: Napoleon successfully directs the Siege of Toulon, gaining recognition as a military strategist.

name: Napoleon's Italian Campaign
description: Napoleon leads the French Army to victory in the Italian Campaign, establishing French control over Northern Italy.

name: Egyptian Campaign
description: Napoleon leads a military expedition to Egypt, aiming to disrupt British trade interests and establish French presence in the region.

name: Napoleon's Consulate
description: Napoleon overthrows the Directory and becomes the First Consul of France.

name: Napoleonic Code
description: Napoleon introduces the Napoleonic Code, a comprehensive civil code that reformed the French legal system.

name: Coronation of Napoleon
description: Napoleon Bonaparte is crowned Emperor of the French at Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris.

name: Battle of Austerlitz
description: Napoleon achieves a decisive victory against Austria and Russia in the Battle of Austerlitz.

name: Continental System
description: Napoleon imposes the Continental System, a blockade against British goods to weaken the British economy.

name: Peninsular War
description: The Peninsular War begins, as Napoleon's forces invade Spain and Portugal.

name: Invasion of Russia
description: Napoleon leads the Grande Armée into Russia, resulting in a disastrous campaign with heavy losses.

name: Battle of Leipzig
description: Napoleon suffers a defeat against the Sixth Coalition in the Battle of Leipzig.

name: First Abdication of Napoleon
description: After multiple military defeats, Napoleon abdicates the throne and is exiled to the island of Elba.

name: The Hundred Days
description: Napoleon returns from exile and briefly regains power during the Hundred Days.

name: Battle of Waterloo
description: Napoleon is defeated by the Seventh Coalition in the Battle of Waterloo, leading to his final abdication.

name: Exile to Saint Helena
description: Napoleon is exiled to the island of Saint Helena, where he spends the rest of his life.
